# SurgicalHUT

> Leading medical supply store in Lahore, Pakistan offering surgical equipment, diagnostic devices, and healthcare products from international brands.

SurgicalHUT distributes a comprehensive range of medical equipment including physiotherapy machines, sterilization equipment, ophthalmic devices, dental products, and disposable medical supplies. They represent major international brands like Nihon Kohden, Anspach, BRIGHTWAY, and others, serving healthcare professionals across Pakistan.
